lead: Nvidia / NVDA — A blowout quarter, and the crowd sells anyway
smaller: Bitcoin / BTC-USD — Binance changes chiefs, the dip gets bought
Deere / DE — The farm boom hits its first frost
Nasdaq 100 3x ETF / TQQQ — Borrowing big while the fear gauge sleeps
why_lead: Nvidia's first post-results session (2023-11-22) closed down 2.46% at 487.16 USD despite newly published blowout coverage (n1236, n0977, n1234, n1235), while AMD (+2.81%) and Arm (+5.28%) rose: a beat-and-fade that flips the 2023-11-21 pre-report lead and the 2023-11-22 smaller item. Attention: the next-Nvidia pitch (n0989), Huang wealth coverage (n0868), SOXL +53.64% over 20 sessions; analog is the crowded-winner mechanism with Goldman's record crowding (n0699) and Bloomberg's great-is-good-enough frame (n1189); smart money split between the WSJ/Goldman deployment bulls (n1236, n1135) and AI-hype cooling (n0336); breaks at the 417.79 USD 20-session reference, China export rules (n1225), leverage and rotation.
why_smaller: Bitcoin: material update of the 2023-11-22 lead on newly published evidence (new Binance CEO n1059, CZ bond n1053) and a sharp rebound (+4.52% BTC, +6.57% ETH, +10.75% SOL; BONK listing n1057): the dip got bought, a reversal of yesterday's contagion fear; bond-review, Bittrex and single-source ETF claims (n1048, n1055) supply the break.
Deere: a concrete results catalyst (2024 guidance miss, n0939; -3.11% to 370.76 USD) and a different narrative, the quality cyclical meeting a turning farm cycle (n0938, n0983).

TQQQ: the complacency/leverage trade as the VIX sat at 12.85 points (-36.35% over 20 sessions) and TQQQ rose 35.49% over 20 sessions, with leveraged-ETF rankings (n1813) and a pre-holiday close higher (n0187); BlackRock's volatility view, a recession call and record crowding (n1483, n2063, n0841) supply the break.

considered_not_chosen.reason: +1.28% on Altman's reinstatement (n1949, n1952), but Microsoft led on 2023-11-20 and was a smaller item on 2023-11-21; used as cross-asset context in the lead.
Record-sales previews (n0101, n1948) but Ross was a smaller item on 2023-11-22 and the event is still pending.
+10.75% and +43.23% over 20 sessions with the BONK listing (n1057), folded into the Bitcoin item; Solana already appeared on 2023-11-02, 2023-11-13 and 2023-11-16.

selection_memory.lead_material_change: Nvidia led on 2023-11-21 (pending results) and was a smaller results item on 2023-11-22. It returns as lead, not back-to-back, because newly published post-results coverage (n1236, n0977, n1234, n1235, all 2023-11-22) and the first post-results session (-2.46%) flip the story from anticipation to a beat-and-fade with rotation into AMD and Arm. Bitcoin, the 2023-11-22 lead, is demoted to a smaller material update on newly published Binance leadership and bond evidence (n1059, n1053).
